verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework with documented telephony support (carrier webhooks for Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo and SIP, plus PSTN transport), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents sending DTMF keypresses, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail. General telephony transport is adjacent and does not count as this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
